lede: The week's biggest item is in Ouray County, where the Planning Commission holds three public hearings on August 19 — including a full repeal of Section 16 of the county's land use regulations, a move that could rewrite the rules for future development across the county. Closer to home, SMART's board votes on two resolutions restructuring the Gondola Advisory Committee and its professional contracts, and San Miguel County's Planning Commission takes up both a subdivision work session and an energy code update that would raise building standards on new construction.
